central_topic: Predicting unmeasured MTEB text-embedding benchmark scores for held-out models from a small queried benchmark budget using low-rank score-matrix prediction and historically calibrated local residual corrections.
core_methods: Masked, column-centered, ridge-regularized low-rank matrix factorization fitted by alternating least squares, with conditional ridge inference for new models

Cross-fitted historical donor residuals with overlap-aware Gaussian-kernel weights, target-wise weighted medians, effective-count shrinkage, and history-only blend selection including a zero-correction fallback
Greedy integrated predictive-variance reduction for selecting benchmark columns from latent-factor covariance; score values condition prediction, not the query ordering
Evaluated alternative: overlap-shrunk pairwise covariance, positive-semidefinite repair, and self-excluding conditional transfer selection
comparators: Cold-start collaborative filtering and regularized matrix completion
Local conditional-median regression under absolute-error loss and neighborhood prediction
V-optimal experimental design and active rating elicitation under a query budget; related design literature, not a completed design ablation
Shrinkage covariance estimation with incomplete observations; connected to the evaluated covariance alternative
tinyBenchmarks: example-level evaluation compression, distinct from selecting whole benchmark columns
Observational Scaling Laws and Sloth: latent-capability and skill-based multi-benchmark performance prediction; literature comparators, not implemented experimental baselines
benchmarks: MTEB text-embedding task scores from embeddings-benchmark/results at revision 6dabbcc68c28ea5f180ce7df79347b3ca9cc6383; supported English main-metric task/subset columns, normalized to [0,1]; 127 search-plane model rows and 126 final-plane model rows, with 135 columns in the final plane
result_driven_themes: Final aggregate MAE falls from 0.04523334197776794 at one query to 0.03615046021288207 at eight queries; literature on cold-start elicitation helps contextualize this measured budget-error tradeoff without declaring eight queries sufficient

The selected combined estimator achieves final MAE 0.040807843083862115 versus reported best-baseline MAE 0.045249969215420516; no independent outer ablations isolate residual calibration, shrinkage, cross-fitting, or selection as the cause

Constant-history and independently permuted-column controls have higher aggregate MAE than intact history; this motivates cross-column dependence as a theme but is not a formal causal attribution or significance claim

Evaluation covers duplicate-group and heuristic family-plus-duplicate holdouts with sealed common targets; these are relatedness controls, not evidence of an encoder-to-decoder or other architectural transition

queries.query: regularized matrix factorization alternating least squares cold-start collaborative filtering
queries.rationale: The selected source actually fits masked ridge ALS factors and infers a new model from observed columns; this supplies the established matrix-completion and cold-start foundation rather than an invented neural architecture.

queries.query: kernel weighted conditional median regression absolute loss
queries.rationale: The best successful configuration transports cross-fitted donor residuals using Gaussian profile weights and target-wise weighted medians with shrinkage. Conditional-median literature explains the MAE motivation, without claiming the full clipped residual estimator is Bayes-optimal or independently validated.

queries.query: V-optimal experimental design Bayesian linear regression integrated predictive variance
queries.rationale: The preserved latent-factor selector maximizes summed predictive covariance reduction. Prediction-oriented V-optimal design is a closer match than labeling it D-optimal information gain; related design rules remain literature comparators, not completed ablations.

queries.query: covariance estimation missing observations shrinkage positive semidefinite
queries.rationale: A separately evaluated configuration replaces low-rank ALS with overlap-dependent covariance shrinkage and eigenvalue repair. It scored worse during search, so this is a bounded methodological contrast, not the central contribution or a matched final negative result.
